thread:
IncidentBot: PAGER — service:model-serving (prod, us-west-2) p99 latency breach > 2s (alert threshold 800ms). Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/generate. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency>.

Alex (oncall): ack, I'm looking. tagging SRE and runtime.

Alex (oncall): quick metrics dump — p95 went from ~120ms to ~860ms over last 15m, p99 ~2.3s. Error budget burn starting.

Eli (SRE): seeing a spike in streaming stall_count on the proxy and a 6x jump in KV-cache miss rate around 03:06. Correlates with calibration deploy: fp8-profile-v2 at 03:05 (canary -> 40%).

Rita (eng-ml): confirmed — fp8-profile-v2 was promoted to canary at 03:05 as part of the cadence. It changes per-layer scale params and uses a new dequant kernel. Canary was set to 40% traffic for inference and streaming.

Sam (eng-runtime): logs from runtime hosts show heavy CPU on dequant path and extra memcpy ops for long-context streams. Stack sample snippet: 
```
# stack samples (truncated)
dequant_kernel() +0x12f
copy_kv_cache() +0x88
stream_chunk_dispatch() +0x64
```
Suggest routing streaming routes off fp8 canary.

Alex (oncall): agree. Initiating live mitigation: reduce canary to 0% for streaming routes and pin /v1/stream to fp16-compat model variant. Will run rollback if needed.

Maya (ops): preparing routing change. FYI we have autoscale headroom but stalls are holding open connections so scaling won't help until kernel overhead removed.

Luis (CS): a small number of customers reported increased lag and a couple of streaming sessions dropped; no widespread data loss reported. Notified two affected enterprise customers — they are waiting for ETA.

Alex (oncall): executing routing change now. Command (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/routing/update \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","model_variant":"fp16-fallback","traffic_percent":100}'
```
Applying...

IncidentBot: change applied by Alex (oncall) at 03:22. Canary traffic for fp8-profile-v2 reduced to 0% for streaming routes.

Eli (SRE): within 3 minutes post-change p95 dropped from 860ms -> 160ms, p99 down to ~340ms. Streaming stall_count trending down.

Rita (eng-ml): thanks — will abort the canary promotion and collect full perf traces from hosts that ran fp8-profile-v2. We need to diff kernel perf vs previous dequant.

Sam (eng-runtime): opened a runtime ticket: RUNTIME-4392 — observed extra memcpy rounds in the new dequant; suspect non-vectorized path on certain AVX/ARM codegens. Assigning to Sam and eng-ml.

Jane (SRE Lead): good mitigation. Escalate to postmortem and add action items: stricter perf gating for calibration changes, streaming-specific perf tests in CI, and a rollback play in canary pipeline.

Luis (CS): customer update sent: "We identified a perf regression tied to a calibration profile change and have routed your traffic to a fallback variant. Monitoring shows latency returned to normal. We'll follow up with a postmortem and timeline for a safe fix." They asked for ETA; gave 2-4 hours for full analysis.

Alex (oncall): handing off to Eli for monitoring/cleanup — I'm stepping off the incident at 04:05. Eli, please own until closure.

Eli (SRE): taking over. Current metrics: p95 ~150ms, p99 ~330ms, error budget burn paused. Kept one observer for 30m.

Rita (eng-ml): collecting perf traces and model invocation logs for canary cohort. Noted that long-context (>2048 tokens) calls had worst regressions. We'll add targeted tests for long-context streaming in the calibration pipeline.

Sam (eng-runtime): temporary runtime-level mitigation idea: detect fp8 dequant path and use a fast-path fallback for streaming (avoid extra memcpy) — prototype in a branch, but needs eng-ml review.

Maya (ops): removing temporary extra routing rules at 04:30. No more stalled connections observed in the last 12m.

Jane (SRE Lead): schedule postmortem kickoff in #postmortems with owners: Rita (eng-ml) owner, Sam (eng-runtime) co-owner, Eli (SRE) facilitator. Deadline: draft within 48h.

Luis (CS): flagged impacted customers for follow-up and offered credits as appropriate. Recording CS ticket IDs.

Eli (SRE): monitoring for an additional 1h then will close incident if stable. Collecting flamegraphs and perf counters from fp8 hosts.

Rita (eng-ml): immediate next steps: revert dequant kernel change in code branch, add streaming long-context perf tests, and add a canary stop condition when streaming stall_count increases >3x baseline.

Sam (eng-runtime): added RUNTIME-4392 notes and a small hotfix branch (no rollouts until eng-ml signoff).

Alex (oncall): thanks team. Good coordination. If anything regresses ping @Alex again.

IncidentBot: Incident acknowledged and mitigated — Monitoring in recovery. Incident channel: #incidents. Postmortem ticket: PM-8721 (assigned)."
